newsitem.title: UK: Bardon and Camas expected to merge-FT.
newsitem.headline: Bardon and Camas expected to merge-FT.

text.p: British building materials firms Bardon Group Plc and Camas Plc could announce a 500 million pounds merger on Monday, the Fianncial Times newspaper said.
"A link-up between the two Midlands-based groups would create one of the biggest companies in the UK aggregates industry, with combined sales of more than 725 million pounds," the report said.

The paper noted that the two had attemepted a marriage a year ago, but failed to agree a management structure. A deal now would continue the consolidation of the industry which saw market leader Tarmac Plc take over rival George Wimpey Plc's construction materials division last year in a swap for its housebuilding business.
